meta_title: The Gas Works | Emergency Plumber Sunderland
meta_description: The Gas Works in Sunderland offers rapid emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, and heating installation. Same-day response, 24/7 availability. Call now for fast help.
hero_subhead: Burst pipes, boiler breakdowns, or heating faults in Sunderland? We arrive fast and fix it right, day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Sunderland
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to full system installations, we handle every plumbing and heating challenge for homes and businesses.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to resolve most faults the same day, any time.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Keep your heating running safely. Annual gas boiler servicing, emergency fault diagnosis, and repairs — all Gas Safe certified.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted with a 10-year warranty and full system commissioning. We advise on efficiency and help with grant schemes where available.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold radiators repaired or replaced. System balancing and power flushing included to restore full heat output.

services.title: Pipe Work & System Installation
services.desc: Central heating system design, installation, and upgrades. Includes pressure testing and full compliance certification.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Blockage Clearance
services.desc: Stubborn drain blockages cleared fast using high-pressure jetting. We locate the problem and fix it without unnecessary digging.

about_pullquote: I started The Gas Works to give Sunderland honest, fast plumbing without the cowboys' inflated bills.
about_para_1: The Gas Works has been serving Sunderland homes and businesses for 18 years. Founded on the principle that good plumbing should be reliable, affordable, and fast, we've built our reputation by turning up on time, diagnosing faults clearly, and fixing them properly — without unnecessary upsells. Every engineer is Gas Safe registered and fully trained in modern heating systems.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we answer the phone 24/7, arrive within an hour for emergencies, and stand behind our work with written guarantees. We're local, we know Sunderland inside out, and we treat every job — whether a simple tap washer or a full system overhaul — with the same care and attention.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare leak in the kitchen on a Sunday evening. Called The Gas Works in desperation and they were at the door in 50 minutes. Fixed the burst pipe, dried everything down, and even gave me advice on preventing it happening again. Brilliant service, very fair price. Can't ask for better.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: My old boiler finally gave up. Phoned around for quotes and The Gas Works came out next day. The engineer explained exactly what I needed, helped me understand the options, and didn't push me towards the most expensive model. Installation was smooth, paperwork sorted, and the new boiler is running perfectly. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer L.

reviews.text: Annual boiler service, routine stuff really, but the engineer was thorough and spotted a small issue with the controls that could have become a problem. Fixed it on the spot, no extra charge. That's the kind of attention to detail that keeps me calling them back.
reviews.author: David H.
